intro: Matilda's poses, Max's poses and the four Unit 1.1 nouns redrawn in the flat style of the prototype's max.webp (max_s1): same style text, NAG off, no negative prompt, palette as colours only. Matilda's poses reuse her exact matilda_stand_s4 text with only the pose and expression words changed; Max's reuse max_s1's text plus his shirt details (blue V-neck and sleeve trims, rosy cheeks). 6 seeds per pose, 5 per noun. Each section shows the old prototype file, the chosen seed (teal border) and the runner-up seeds. Tap an image for the full-size PNG. These files are now in the prototype under the same names.
